title: Meme Off.
text:
This is, of course, the CPT code for interactive complexity as an add-on to a psychotherapy visit.

One of my contentions is that memes are actually a really great way of communicating information concisely. So, I’ve been working on a lot of them, as you have probably noticed in the column. Not everything ends up fitting with what I’m writing, so this is a section where we can have some of those see the light of day. I hope this inspires a meme-based discussion. Please feel free to respond with your own, in meme format:

I have a slightly absurd piece that didn’t make the cut about the One Medical acquisition being a mix up. It may show up later, if my editor can figure out what to do with it.

This guy clearly loves his EHR.

It’s a big company.

One of the last successful ways of complying with the DEA is by making sure you have plenty of filing cabinets for them to examine.

And, of course, the great healthcare mergers and acquisitions battle of our time.

Navigating a health-tech start up can be hellish.

Twitter is Meme Central. Recognize the thought leaders?

Healthcare memes: join the throw down.
